Corporate Governance

Responsibility, transparency and sustainable corporate management

Learn more

Principles of corporate governance

Rosenbauer is committed to compliance with the Austrian Corporate Governance Code (download at www.corporategovernance.at). In this way, Rosenbauer ensures responsible, transparent and long-term oriented corporate management and control. The Code is based on the regulations of Austrian stock corporation, stock exchange and capital market law, the EU recommendations on the duties of supervisory board members and the remuneration of directors, and the principles of the OECD Guidelines for Corporate Governance. This Corporate Governance Report is based on the Code as amended in Jänner 2025.

Corporate Governance Report 2025, April 2026

Evaluation Report OECGK 2024, April 2025 (only available in German)

Directors' Dealings

Directors' dealings include transactions in financial instruments carried out by persons with managerial responsibilities within the company. Natural and legal persons who have a close relationship with these executives are also subject to the reporting obligation. Until July 2, 2016, these transactions were published in the Directors' Dealings database of the Financial Market Authority (FMA).

  • Articles of Association Rosenbauer International AG

    The Articles of Association form the legal framework of Rosenbauer International AG, defining key aspects such as the company name, registered office in Leonding, business purpose, as well as its capital and governance structure. They set the foundation within which Rosenbauer operates as a global leader in firefighting and safety solutions.

    Articles of Association
  • Renumeration Policy

    The remuneration policy was approved by 98.9% of the share capital present, i.e. 74.8% of the total capital, at the Annual General Meeting on May 8, 2025.
